claim: The FM-Bessel Isomorphism: the sideband amplitudes are exactly Jₙ(β) — 'not an approximation' — and the forward vector names the test: walk the ear through the zero at 2.405 where the carrier vanishes.

pieces.what: A β slider on one FM pair with the Jₙ curves drawn beside the live spectrum; at β = 2.405 the carrier drops out and the reader hears it go. Tests the exactness claim at its sharpest point.
A struck circular membrane: its first modes at the Bessel-zero ratios against a string's integer ratios, struck at centre and near the rim.
J₀, J₁, J₃ played as waveforms, with the order n as a morph knob, so the delayed peak near t = n is heard.
